title: Jailbroken: How Does LLM Safety Training Fail?
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying the technical and optimization failure modes of safety training in Large Language Models (LLMs) through adversarial jailbreaking. While the datasets used for evaluation include prompts related to social bias and religious groups (e.g., Judaism), the study aims to analyze the robustness of refusal mechanisms from a security and safety perspective rather than to benchmark or evaluate religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks themselves.
